results.description: Sports Mole looks at the head-to-head record and previous meetings between Real Madrid and Rayo Vallecano.

results.title: TF35 Versoix Grand Prix on Lake Geneva Preview
results.description: TF35 racing resumes tomorrow on Lake Geneva with the TF35 Versoix Grand Prix, the second event of the autumn series and the sixth, and penultimate, meeting of the season. Racing will take place from 11-13 September, hosted by the Club Nautique de Versoix.

results.title: Merlin Rocket Silver Tiller at Upper Thames
results.description: The day of the Upper Thames Craftinsure Silver Tiller (combined Rowsell Sails Thames Series and Craftinsure Vintage Series event) started perfectly on Sunday 6th September, with Merlin Rocket sailors waking up fresh, well-rested and raring to go.

results.title: Tennessee Tech Football Coach Launches Character Attack On Rival After Cheating Accusations
results.description: Tennessee Tech took down Chattanooga in Southern Conference football action last weekend, kickstarting September with a rivalry win. After the game, Mocs coach Rusty Wright took issue with the Golden Eagles‘ alignment on a second half onside kick. His counterpart rejected accusations of rule breaking.
